messages:
rong: Deploybot paused promotion for release v4.0.0 during change window. Reason: artifact cache miss + failing smoke (1/3 infra timeout). CI: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/110055 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=cache_miss_and_smoke_flake, artifact=worker@sha256:1122aabb, auto_retries=2
sara: logs snippet:
```
WARN cache: read miss for artifacts/worker/sha256:1122aabb
ERROR smoke-test: ephemeral-redis failed to bind port (EADDRINUSE)
```
sara: It retried twice then paused. Looks like registry served a redirect 202 earlier and cache index didn't update on the replica region.
devops-lead: Options: (1) short hold 5m and auto-rerun, (2) manual promote last-known-good to avoid missing change window, (3) full rebuild+rerun (likely miss window). Thoughts?
rong: last-known-good is worker@sha256:00ff3344 promoted to stable ~90m ago. No reported regressions.
qa-bot: Quick risk: unit/integration green for last-good; smoke flaky historically when redis port collisions happen in test infra (not artifact code).
ops-oncall: We should prefer manual pin to keep change window. Also create follow-up to check cache write propagation and replica index cron.
devops-lead: Agreed. Need an approver to proceed with manual promote and a short release-note entry. @sara can you ack?
sara: ack +1 to manual promote. Note: annotate release notes: "Pinned to previous worker artifact due to transient cache propagation; follow-up to investigate replica index lag."
devops-lead: Executing promote: `deployctl promote --artifact worker@sha256:00ff3344 --target=stable --reason "cache propagation; smoke flake" --annotate "manual pin; follow-up: TKT-6532"`
deploy-bot: Promotion executed by devops-lead. stable -> worker@sha256:00ff3344. Release metadata updated.
rong: Change window unblocked. Creating TKT-6532: "Investigate artifact index propagation to replica regions causing cache misses during promote" and assigning infra.
qa-bot: Follow-up plan: rerun original build CI after window; if it passes and artifact checksums match, decision to re-promote or keep pinned. If it fails, open rollback/hotfix plan.
sara: leaving reminder: check registry client logs for 202 responses and index cron timestamps.
devops-lead: Thanks everyone. Closing thread — ping here if rerun outcome requires action. :rocket:
